summary: Iteration 285 — Invoice Tracking + Email + Stripe Integration. Backend: 22/22 tests passed (1 skipped). Frontend: All new UI components verified including billing panel, invoice tracking table, status badges, action buttons, send dialogs, and cost center accounting_email management.
critical_code_review_comments: INVOICE CREATION: POST /api/invoices creates snapshot with kind='aggregate'|'catering_aggregate' — returns invoice_id, status='draft', snapshot{lines, total}
INVOICE LIST: GET /api/invoices with ?status=draft filter working correctly
INVOICE DETAIL: GET /api/invoices/{id} returns full invoice with snapshot
INVOICE PDF: GET /api/invoices/{id}/pdf returns valid PDF (verified %PDF magic bytes)
INVOICE APPROVE: POST /api/invoices/{id}/approve changes status draft→approved; returns 400 if already approved
INVOICE SEND-EMAIL: POST /api/invoices/{id}/send-email requires approval first; returns 400 without to_email and no accounting_email on cost center
INVOICE SEND-STRIPE: POST /api/invoices/{id}/send-stripe requires external_customer_email; returns 400 without email
INVOICE VOID: POST /api/invoices/{id}/void works on draft/approved; returns 400 on paid invoices
STRIPE WEBHOOK: POST /api/stripe-webhook with type='invoice.paid' and metadata.meetflow_invoice_id updates status to 'paid'
COST CENTER EMAIL: PUT /api/cost-centers/{id} with accounting_email updates the field correctly
PERMISSION CHECK: Non-admin users without bookings.invoice capability get 403 on all invoice endpoints
FRONTEND BILLING TAB: [data-testid=tab-billing] visible in Resources page
FRONTEND TRACKING PANEL: [data-testid=invoices-tracking-panel] with [data-testid=invoices-table] showing 13 invoices
FRONTEND STATUS FILTER: [data-testid=invoices-status-filter] dropdown filters invoice list
FRONTEND STATUS BADGES: Color-coded badges (Entwurf=gray, Freigegeben=yellow, Versendet=blue, Bezahlt=green, Storniert=red with strikethrough)
FRONTEND ACTION BUTTONS: PDF, Approve, Send-Email, Send-Stripe, Void buttons with correct data-testid attributes
FRONTEND SEND DIALOG: [data-testid=invoice-send-dialog] with email input, customer name (Stripe), message (Email), cancel/confirm buttons

FRONTEND COST CENTER: Admin > System > Ressourcen > Kostenstellen & Konten shows [data-testid=cc-email-input] for new CC and [data-testid=cc-email-edit-{code}]/[data-testid=cc-email-save-{code}] for existing CCs

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 285 tested successfully. All P2-Backlog Billing features implemented: (1) Invoice snapshot persistence with status workflow (draft→approved→sent→paid), (2) Auto-email with PDF attachment via SMTP (or fallback), (3) Stripe invoicing for external customers. Cost centers now have accounting_email field for auto-send. Stripe API is in test mode (sk_test_emergent) - real Stripe calls are made but no actual charges. Webhook signature verification is disabled in dev mode (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET not set). 13 test invoices exist in the system with various statuses for UI testing.
